projects.title: Noble Matrimonial
projects.shortDescription: Designed a modern matrimonial platform focused on trust, simplicity, accessibility, and premium user experience.
projects.problemStatement: Existing matrimonial platforms are often cluttered, overwhelmed with intrusive ads, lacking privacy controls, and presenting outdated visual design that reduces trust among young professionals.
projects.research: Conducted 18 semi-structured interviews with single professionals aged 24-38. 82% cited privacy as their primary concern, while 74% desired clear match compatibility signals without overwhelming profiles.

designProcess.description: User interviews, competitive analysis of 6 regional platforms, persona creation.
Low-fidelity layouts prioritizing profile verification badges & match preference filters.
Dark luxury palette with warm accent accents, high-contrast typography, & spacious cards.
Figma interactive prototype testing micro-interactions for profile bookmarking.
5 user usability sessions resulting in 94% task completion rate for profile setup.
Complete Figma design system component library & developer handoff token guidelines.

projects.title: Fishinity Pro
projects.shortDescription: Created a clean analytics dashboard with intuitive navigation and data visualization for enterprise users.
projects.problemStatement: Enterprise marine logistics operators required a real-time data monitoring platform to track fleet metrics, catch yields, and fuel consumption without cognitive overload.
projects.research: Observed operator workflows in live operations. Identified key bottlenecks in multi-tab navigation and high alert fatigue caused by un-prioritized notifications.

designProcess.description: Contextual inquiry with 12 fleet operators, mapping telematics streams.
Modular widget system allowing custom dashboard grid arrangements.
High-contrast dark mode layout optimized for multi-monitor command stations.
Simulated real-time chart updates and alert toast transitions.
Reduced operator reaction time to critical system alerts by 38%.
Exported React UI component specs and Recharts integration guidelines.

typography.sampleText: Precision Analytics for Modern Marine Telematics.

projects.title: FLiPP Productions
projects.shortDescription: Designed a modern entertainment website featuring merchandise, artist branding, event promotion, and responsive layouts.
projects.problemStatement: FLiPP Productions needed an immersive digital storefront to showcase music releases, book tour tickets, and sell exclusive merchandise seamlessly in a unified brand experience.
projects.research: Analyzed top global record label sites and indie artist stores. Found that 68% of visitors abandon checkout when routed to third-party event ticketing sites.

designProcess.description: Artist brand identity mapping, e-commerce drop workflow analysis.
Full-bleed video hero headers, fluid merchandise carousel grid.
High-energy luxury dark theme with editorial typography and kinetic hover effects.
Smooth page transitions and interactive audio player drawer.
Mobile checkout test achieved 4.8/5 satisfaction score across 20 test users.
Webflow ready design tokens & custom motion specifications.

projects.title: ShelterMax Protection
projects.shortDescription: Designed a premium corporate website emphasizing trust, security, and strong visual hierarchy.
projects.problemStatement: ShelterMax lacked a cohesive digital presence that reflected their high-net-worth security consultation services, leading to low conversion on enterprise inquiry forms.
projects.research: Evaluated C-suite decision-making habits. Trust, credibility signals, executive testimonials, and clear service matrices were identified as non-negotiable conversion drivers.

designProcess.description: C-suite buyer persona interviews, trust signal analysis.
Structured corporate hero, comparison matrices, and clear consultation CTA.
Minimalist luxury aesthetic with geometric card grids and subtle borders.
Interactive quote calculator and secure portal entry preview.
A/B testing verified 42% increase in qualified consultation requests.
Responsive Figma system & client CMS structure documentation.

typography.sampleText: Uncompromising Protection For What Matters Most.

projects.title: Zenith Pay
projects.shortDescription: A next-generation mobile banking experience prioritizing speed, biometrics, and effortless international transfers.
projects.problemStatement: Fintech apps are often cluttered with secondary ads and confusing menus. Users needed a frictionless 1-tap transfer experience.
projects.research: Interviews with 25 frequent remitters revealed 3 key steps: balance view, contact select, instant send.

designProcess.description: Remittance pain point analysis & biometric security UX.
Dark high contrast mobile layouts with haptic feedback specs.

projects.title: Aura Design System
projects.shortDescription: Scalable multi-platform design system with 200+ accessible components, tokens, and guidelines.
projects.problemStatement: Inconsistent design components across 4 cross-functional product teams led to bloated CSS and poor accessibility scores.
projects.research: Audited existing product repositories and unified color tokens, typographic scales, and spacing primitives.

designProcess.description: Mapped 140 variant components down to 32 core primitives.
Set up Figma design tokens mapped directly to CSS variables.
